name: Wall Chest Stretch
focus: Chest and front of the shoulder
description: Stretches the chest: forearm flat on a wall beside you with the elbow at shoulder height, step forward and turn your body away from the wall.

source.title: 5 Chest Stretch Variations (ACE)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Place your right forearm flat on the wall, elbow bent to 90° at shoulder height.
cues: Step forward with the foot nearest the wall.
Turn your chest away from the wall until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulder down and relaxed.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and breathe slowly.

keyframes.name: Forearm on the wall
keyframes.cue: Elbow at shoulder height, forearm up the wall.

keyframes.name: Turn away
keyframes.cue: Step forward and turn your chest away from the wall.
